prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in Baytown, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1376; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling in the right lane of a multi-lane roadway in Baytown, Texas, when Driver 2 moved into the same lane without signaling and made contact with the left side of Driver 1's vehicle. The sideswipe left scrape marks and a crushed rear quarter panel on Driver 1's vehicle, and the damage pattern is consistent with the impact described by both drivers. Driver 2 stated that the lane change was made without checking the mirror and acknowledged the contact at the scene. Photographs taken at the scene show the damage locations, and two independent witnesses gave statements that match the sequence of events reported by both drivers. A Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat of Driver 1's vehicle, and both witnesses and responding officers confirmed the Passenger's presence at the time of the collision. Driver 1 reported pain in the lower back and was evaluated at the scene, where the complaint was consistent with the force of a side impact. Officers observed no prior damage to the vehicle and no earlier repairs were noted. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy covering the vehicle involved.
